name: Vase with Peonies and Five Spouts
material: green-glazed porcelaneous stoneware with incised decoration, Yue ware
dimensions: Diameter: 16.2 cm (6 3/8 in.); Overall: 26.4 cm (10 3/8 in.)
summary: "In full autumn wind and dew the kilns of Yue open; And a thousand peaks are despoiled of their halcyon green" (translated by S. W. Bushell).
